Processen en documentatie: processen, vereisten en werkwijzen analyseren en beschrijven, met aandacht voor duidelijke, consistente en bruikbare documentatie.

Samenwerking en stakeholderondersteuning: vlot samenwerken met uiteenlopende betrokkenen en helder communiceren met zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders.

• Je hebt een relevante academische achtergrond en ervaring met data- of governancevraagstukken.

• Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring in functionele analyse en vereistenbeheer .

• Je beschikt over sterk inzicht in datasystemen en integratiecontext .

• Je kan werken met Python en SQL om data-assets te analyseren, documenteren en op te volgen.

title: Database Research Scientist
description:
ClickHouse Labs is an applied research group that works closely with engineering teams to identify challenging problems in database systems and develop novel solutions. Our goal is to advance the state of the art and translate research ideas into real-world system improvements.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Research Scientist at ClickHouse Labs, you will work on high-impact problems at the intersection of database systems, distributed systems, AI, and systems software engineering while collaborating with experienced researchers and engineers. The role covers a broad range of problems across database systems research and engineering, including but not limited to query optimization, execution engines, distributed systems, consensus protocols, materialized views, indexing and data structures, benchmarking, workload analysis, and emerging agentic workloads.

In this role, you will work on leading open-source database systems (e.g., ClickHouse, PostgreSQL). You will investigate performance and scalability bottlenecks in production-quality systems, develop new algorithms and system designs, and evaluate them under realistic workloads and hardware configurations. Projects may involve improving query planning and execution, reducing CPU and memory overhead, increasing throughput and concurrency, scaling across distributed deployments, or redesigning system components to leverage modern hardware better. You will work closely with engineers to turn successful ideas into robust implementations that can be deployed and maintained in widely used open-source systems.

Researchers are encouraged to publish their work, contribute to open-source projects, participate in leading research conferences, and pursue ambitious projects with strong engineering and research support.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Conduct applied research aimed at advancing the performance, scalability, reliability, and functionality of open-source database management systems, including ClickHouse and PostgreSQL.

- Design and evaluate new algorithms, data structures, and system architectures for areas such as query optimization, indexing, storage management, query execution, and distributed data management.

- Develop high-quality research prototypes and production-grade implementations, and work with engineering teams to integrate successful techniques into open-source and production systems.

- Collaborate closely with database engine, infrastructure, and data-plane engineers to identify high-impact research problems and translate research results into practical system improvements.

- Analyze large-scale database workloads, performance traces, benchmarks, and production telemetry to identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities.

- Design rigorous experiments and benchmarks to evaluate new techniques across realistic workloads, hardware configurations, and deployment environments.

- Communicate research results through technical reports, open-source contributions, internal presentations, and publications at leading database and systems venues (e.g., SIGMOD, VLDB, CIDR).

- Contribute to the broader technical direction of ClickHouse Labs by identifying emerging research opportunities and helping shape longer-term research projects.

QUALIFICATIONS

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

- Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field, with research experience in databases, distributed systems, systems software, or machine learning systems.

- Strong publication record in leading peer-reviewed research venues such as SIGMOD, VLDB, SOSP, OSDI, NSDI, or NeurIPS, with work relevant to databases or systems.

You embed directly with customer teams as the engineer on the ground: own an outcome, ship a production-grade SpaceXAI system that still runs after you leave, and become the critical technical feedback loop from the field back to product engineering.

The work is the project. One week you might take a messy business workflow and put a production agent on it: pick the use case, stand up the architecture, wire it into the customer’s auth, data, and tools, then harden it with evals until the team actually uses it. Another week you might live in a customer’s repo and delivery system and ship an agent-powered path for a migration, a PR review loop, or an incident-to-fix flow, behind tests, review, and rollout rather than in a chat sidebar. Either way, you measure what matters, leave the customer able to operate it, and bring the pattern back as another use case for SpaceXAI.

title: Chief Product Officer
description:
Description
Muse Group 's products - spanning learning, playing, creating, publishing, and buying music - reach over 100 million musicians, creators, teachers, and music lovers worldwide. Today these are strong but standalone products. Our next chapter is to turn them into one connected ecosystem, where a person moves naturally between learning, playing, practicing, creating and where each product makes the others stronger. The goal is simple: the portfolio should be worth more to the user together than each product on its own.
We are looking for a Chief Product Officer to lead that chapter. This is a mandate to build, not to maintain. Few places in the industry combine this much audience, this much love for the products, and this much still-unwritten product architecture on top of them. You get a rare mix: a ready audience of 100M+, deep content libraries, one of the strongest organic platforms in music, and a clean sheet to assemble it into a connected product. We are starting AI almost from zero, not optimizing an existing layer, so what AI-native means for Muse is yours to define. And all of it is about music and musicians, not product management as an end in itself.
This is a fully remote role open to candidates based in Europe or Cyprus.
Key responsibilities
Group product strategy. Where the portfolio goes; where products stay independent, where they share capabilities, where connecting them creates new value. From priorities to a coherent roadmap, investment model, and product architecture.
One ecosystem for musicians. The connective layer - shared identity, personalization, content portability, cross-product discovery, shared libraries. You make the transitions between products natural and mutually reinforcing.
A North Star for each product - and for the group. For every product, one measure of the real value it creates for the user. And as products connect, a single North Star for the whole ecosystem. This is the compass teams steer by.
The customer lifecycle. You own the whole arc - from first touch to lasting habit: how people arrive, activate, come back, get more value, and stay. We judge product success by that, not by short-term conversion. Monetization strengthens the user relationship instead of working against it.
AI-native product. Define what AI changes in learning, practice, creation, search, and discovery, and build a focused portfolio of AI initiatives with real user value - a product, not a set of demos.
The team and its leaders. Build an exceptional global product organization and grow strong product leaders under each product, so the team is durable, not dependent on one person.
Requirements
An established product leader who has worked at portfolio or ecosystem level, not a single product, and who combines strategic range with closeness to users, data, and product quality.

• Led consumer products, platforms, or digital ecosystems at significant scale.

• A demonstrated record of growing retention, engagement, and user value.

• Systems thinking - can assemble an architecture across products, users, and data.

• Grew strong product leaders instead of keeping decisions to themselves.

What matters to us:
We are looking for someone who thinks in outcomes for the user and the business, not roadmap length; who can protect a product's long-term value from the pull of short-term monetization; who builds a team instead of carrying it alone. The opposite stops us: success measured by feature velocity, treating AI as a tool rollout, and an inability to work without a fully prescribed process.

The Identity Infrastructure Engineering team builds the identity and access systems that OpenAI’s researchers, engineers, and internal teams rely on to protect critical systems and data.

We partner with Research, Applied Engineering, Infrastructure, IT, and Security to make secure access practical across cloud and internal environments.

We’re looking for a hands-on software engineer to design and build high-scale, high-throughput secure access proxies and the distributed systems behind them. These are tier-zero services: researchers, engineers, and agents depend on them to reach critical infrastructure safely and reliably.

You’ll work at the intersection of networking, distributed systems, and infrastructure security, building the serving paths and control-plane integrations that connect identities to resources. Teleport is a core part of the current platform; the role also includes credential brokers, policy enforcement, and developer-facing integrations.

You’ll own the services you build from design and implementation through production. That means understanding human, agent, and workload traffic, improving throughput and tail latency, making authorization decisions auditable, and designing for safe multi-region rollout and recovery. We’re looking for someone who can turn a demanding security requirement into software that works well at scale and is straightforward for other engineers to use.

title: Senior Compliance Manager
description:
Hydrosat is a space and data analytics company leveraging thermal satellite imagery and advanced geospatial intelligence to address some of the world’s most pressing challenges. By combining proprietary satellite technology, Earth observation data and advanced analytics, Hydrosat delivers actionable insights to customers across agriculture, water management, infrastructure, government and defense.
As a rapidly growing, internationally operating company, Hydrosat is expanding its satellite capabilities, commercial activities and government partnerships.
To support this growth, we are looking for an experienced Senior Compliance Manager to strengthen our regulatory compliance capabilities and help ensure that our technologies, operations and commercial activities meet applicable legal and regulatory requirements. As Senior Compliance Manager, you will play a central role in developing, implementing and overseeing Hydrosat ’s regulatory and corporate compliance framework.
Your responsibilities will span export controls, satellite and remote sensing regulations, government and defense-related compliance, international trade restrictions and broader corporate compliance obligations. You will work closely with Legal, Engineering, Product, Commercial, Security and executive leadership to ensure regulatory requirements are understood, appropriately implemented and integrated into business operations.
Responsibilities

• Lead regulatory compliance activities across satellite operations and remote sensing, including applicable FCC, NOAA and European regulatory frameworks, licensing, authorizations and reporting obligations.

• Lead export control and international trade compliance processes under applicable ITAR, EAR, EU dual-use and sanctions regimes, including classifications, licensing, screening and controlled technology/data transfers.

• Advise Engineering, Mission Operations, Product and Commercial teams on regulatory implications of satellite missions, technology development, data distribution and international customer engagements.

• Support government and defense business by assessing relevant contractual, security and controlled-information obligations, working with Legal and Information Security.

• Support foreign ownership, investment screening, and government programme eligibility assessments related to international expansion, new entities, and strategic partnerships.

• Develop and maintain company-wide compliance policies, Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) frameworks, risk assessments and internal controls, including business ethics and anti-corruption measures; coordinate training, regulatory monitoring and external legal advisers as needed.

• Regulatory Calendar & Corporate Compliance: Establish and maintain a centralized compliance calendar across all Hydrosat entities, tracking corporate registrations, statutory filings, license renewals, regulatory reporting obligations, and applicable deadlines at national, state, and local levels. Coordinate with Finance, Legal, Operations, and external advisers to ensure timely compliance.

• Develop and implement risk-based KYC and third-party due diligence processes covering customers, resellers, suppliers, and consultants, including onboarding, screening, and escalation procedures.

• Support ESG compliance initiatives, including applicable sustainability reporting, environmental and governance requirements, working closely with Finance, Legal, and other relevant stakeholders.

Requirements

• 7+ years of experience in regulatory compliance or export controls within the space, aerospace, satellite, defense or similarly regulated technology industries.

• Strong working knowledge of US export controls (ITAR/EAR), international trade restrictions and practical implementation of compliance controls.

• Experience with commercial space, satellite communications or remote sensing regulation, with the ability to navigate licensing and regulatory authority interactions.

title: Junior Email & SMS Marketing Specialist

This is an entry-level role for someone who has foundational knowledge of email or digital marketing and wants to develop deep expertise in lifecycle campaigns, automation, and data-driven optimization. You will work side by side with the Director of Marketing, building real skills in platforms like Twilio and SendGrid while contributing to campaigns that directly impact customer acquisition and retention.
If you are analytical, curious, detail-oriented, and excited about how data and messaging come together to drive results - we want to meet you.

We are a growing company in the sports industry, and our marketing team is at the core of our expansion. This role is an opportunity to go beyond sending emails - you will learn the strategy, the technology, and the data behind lifecycle marketing at a company that moves fast and values results.

• Mentorship from experienced marketers and direct access to senior leadership.

• Hands-on work with enterprise platforms (Twilio, SendGrid) from day one.

• A culture that rewards curiosity, precision, and ownership.

• Flexible remote or hybrid work arrangement.

• A real growth path toward a full Lifecycle Marketing Specialist or Marketing Analyst role.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Campaign Execution & Support

• Assist in building, scheduling, QAing, and launching email and SMS campaigns using Twilio and SendGrid under senior supervision.

title: Senior Software Engineer (f/m/d) Managed NFS
description:
About IONOS

At IONOS, we don't just manage servers - we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure - from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.

What drives us is digital sovereignty for Europe and real impact for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) as well as large enterprises. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit.

Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

IONOS Cloud offers NFS as a managed service, and you develop and maintain it. The product is highly available and redundant, so customer data stays accessible even when a component fails. It runs on Kubernetes and is written mostly in Go.

Tasks

• Develop and maintain the NFS product for IONOS Cloud.

• Build and extend Kubernetes Operators that manage the product's lifecycle.

• Design and implement features that keep the service highly available and redundant, including failover.

• Improve the product's reliability and replication.

• Analyze and resolve complex issues in a highly available, distributed storage setup.

• Migrate from legacy components step by step, without breaking existing customers.

Qualifications

• Expert Go skills and several years of professional development experience.

• Experience developing Kubernetes Operators.

• Solid knowledge of NFS and SMB/CIFS, plus experience with ZFS and DRBD.

• Experience building highly available, redundant systems, including replication, failover and distributed-systems fundamentals (idempotency, retries, consistency, failure handling).

• Deep knowledge of Linux, including the kernel, and experience with LinuxKit and VMs (libvirt, QEMU, cloud-init).

• Fluency with Git, Docker, shell and CI/CD, including GitOps workflows (for example ArgoCD).

• Experience with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana) to monitor availability and troubleshoot issues.

• Daily use of AI coding assistants (for example Claude) in your development work.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and a structured, independent way of working in a team.

• Willingness to undergo a security clearance (SÜ-2).

• Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.

• Numerous training and development opportunities.
